rules: Use Obsidian Black (#0A0A0A) as the global background.
Never use purple/violet gradients on white backgrounds.
Apply the primary gradient (Electric Blue -> Violet -> Orange) sparingly: for active states, hover borders, text masks, or progress bars.
Ensure text contrast ratios meet APCA standards. Use white for primary text, gray for secondary.
Cabinet Grotesk is for all display text (H1, H2, H3) to provide a cinematic, premium feel.
Satoshi is for all body text, UI labels, and meta-data.
Tighten letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter) on all large headings.

glassmorphism: Use 'Optical Clarity' glassmorphism for floating navs, sidebars, and cards over images.
Never use completely transparent backgrounds where text overlays images; always use a glass blur or gradient scrim.
shadows: Use diffuse ambient shadows instead of sharp box shadows.
cinematic_lighting: Use subtle noise or grain over large dark backgrounds to prevent banding and increase texture.
Images should have gradient overlays (from black to transparent) at the bottom to transition smoothly into the page.

component_patterns.sidebar: Persistent left sidebar across the ANCR Ecosystem. Dark surface with glassmorphic active states. Contains Home, Discover, Live, Analytics, Library, etc.
component_patterns.top_bar: Sticky header with backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0A0A]/70. Global search bar (glassmorphic input) and user profile.
component_patterns.ancrwav_player: Persistent bottom bar audio player. Includes dynamic waveform, queue, current track info, and playback controls. Accent color is the Electric Blue -> Orange gradient for the progress bar.
component_patterns.ancrview_player: Cinematic theater mode video player with custom controls, live badge, and embedded interactive playlist/series queue.
component_patterns.cards: Glassmorphic bento cards. No hard borders, just 1px white/[0.05] strokes. Inner padding p-6 to p-8.
component_patterns.world_map: Interactive D3 or React-Simple-Maps global map with glowing nodes (nodes colored in Electric Blue/Orange) for CCDP hubs (Tokyo, London, etc.).

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use gap-8 to gap-12 for sections. py-24 for main page sections.
layouts.grids: Use the Bento Grid Protocol. Mix col-span-full for heroes, col-span-4 for standard cards. Never use perfectly equal squares; embrace asymmetry.

blueprints.home: Cinematic Hero (trending release) -> Bento grid of New Releases -> World Map preview -> Live Events carousel.
blueprints.creator_page: Massive editorial cover photo -> Floating glassmorphic profile card -> Split layout (ANCRWAV audio portfolio on left, ANCRVIEW video portfolio on right).
blueprints.discover: Masonry grid of genre/discipline cards -> Trending charts -> Curated faculty picks.

motion.page_load: Staggered entrance animations. motion.div with y: 20, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1.
motion.hover_states: Slight scale (scale-105) for media covers. Border color transitions to gradient on hover.
motion.players: Smooth height expansion for queue/lyrics opening. Continuous slow progress bar animation.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use raw transparent backgrounds in headers or overlays. Always use a blur/scrim to ensure readability.
Never center align the main App container. Left align text content by default.
Do not use absolute generic transition classes like 'transition-all'. Target specific properties (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform).
Use Lucide-React for icons, DO NOT use emojis for icons.
Utilize Sonner for all toast notifications. Ensure the toast matches the dark premium aesthetic.
Every interactive or informational element MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='play-button', data-testid='discover-nav-link').
Use pre-existing Shadcn components where applicable, but heavily style them to match the Obsidian Black/Glassmorphism theme.
Avoid plain 'SaaS' blocky components; everything should feel editorial, cinematic, and tailored for creators.
Files should be created as .js/.jsx as requested, NOT .tsx.
accessibility: Ensure contrast ratios are at least 4.5:1 for small text and 3:1 for large text.
Focus states must be prominent. Suggestion: ring-2 ring-[#0052FF] ring-offset-2 ring-offset-[#0A0A0A].
Support prefers-reduced-motion for large parallax or entry animations.
